description: Elections Commission - E. M. D. B. Ekanayaka of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - W. A. K. Wagalath and H. C. Herath of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette contains multiple notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their office as Members of the Polgahawela Pradeshiya Sabha due to ceasing membership in a political party. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, fitting the Elections category (Type 7) which includes "electoral commission appointments and decisions" and matters concerning the status of elected representatives.
